count.description: Every published count names its population.

value.description: Omitted when the population is empty or the figure is withheld or unmeasured.

plans.description: plan_id values the report covers (one in plan mode).

engine_version.description: Runtime release version (PM-DIST-1) of the engine that computed the report.

populations.description: Corpus mode: plans per population; plans without a plan instance form the separately sized indeterminate population.

repaired_landings.description: Corpus mode: landed plans a later plan names in repairs (numerator) over the plans that landed (denominator); a lower bound.

structural_limit.description: The step's declared cannotReach class, reported apart from degraded.

yield.description: Per resolution, source and severity: one $defs/count per enum member.

second_reading_yield.description: Committed findings of the second code reading that no finding of the first duplicates, over all committed findings of the two readings (Phase Workflows Specification, second-code-reading); withheld where the plan ran one reading.

escape_distance.description: Per detecting stage (build, self_review, automatic_review, human): one $defs/count.

review_retrospective.description: Null when the plan has no pull request (with the reason in instruments).

footprint.description: Three-way reconciliation results and the assessment comparison state.

spend.description: The tokens used, read from the metrics snapshot, by phase, spend class, and step; null in corpus mode for plans whose metrics are unreadable (counted as floor).

measured_until.description: Instant of the snapshot (plan mode) or the latest snapshot instant folded (corpus mode).

excluded_steps.description: Steps outside the window: the report's own step and every later step of the plan instance in force.

per_phase.description: Per phase: total_tokens with tokens_in and tokens_out as $defs/count, with population stamp and boundary (closed, re_entered, provisional).

per_spend_class.description: Per spend class (submitted, findings_only, no_product, unmeasured) and termination status: one $defs/count.

per_step.description: Per finding-filing step and firing cause: one $defs/count.
